name: Coin Collector 8-bit banner on the home page
hypothesis: Showing the playable 8-bit Coin Collector banner (bonus block, coin counter, direct shop link, OZ.1i and Mezz.1 only) under the value strip gets more home-page visitors to add a cover to their cart than the home page without it. A draft for a future slot; control keeps whatever is in the banner slot when it starts.
